setup: For an angle with sine [[sin_num]]/[[den]] and cosine [[cos_num]]/[[den]], use the Pythagorean triple values rather than a calculator.

steps.say: The cosine numerator is [[cos_num]], so the versine is 1 - [[cos_num]]/[[den]].
The sine numerator is [[sin_num]], so the coversine is 1 - [[sin_num]]/[[den]].
Multiply the required combination by the common denominator [[den]].
